title: Luscious Chicken Casserole
description: A classic comfort dish made with tender chicken, creamy sauce, and a crunchy topping.
instructions: Cook the chicken breast in a skillet over medium-high heat until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes per side.
Set the chicken aside and let it rest for a few minutes before slicing into thin strips.
In a separate skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat. Add the french bread and toast until lightly browned, about 2-3 minutes.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the sliced chicken, toasted bread, and luscious sauce mix. Stir until everything is well coated.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch casserole dish and top with shredded cheese.
Dot the top of the casserole with the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the casserole from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley, if desired. Serve hot and enjoy!
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
